overview_description.description:
Union54 is a debit card issuing API for fintech and corporates. Union54 allows any software company to issue debit cards to their customers without needing any bank or credit card processor. It provides BIN sponsorship., transaction processing, and settlement.

Founded in 2020, Union54 is based in Lusaka, Zambia.

product.name: ChitChat
product.description: A messaging app with an integrated wallet that allows users to store funds in USD or local currency and send money to other users or bank accounts in about 50 countries.

product.name: ChitChat API
product.description: An API that enables developers to build their own branded messaging app with an integrated wallet, supporting fund transfers to mobile wallets and bank accounts in over 50 countries, including KYC and identity verification.

product.name: GovChat
product.description: A messaging app deployed for civil servants to communicate securely among themselves, with optional wallet features for managing travel expenses, per diems, and salaries, hosted on the client's infrastructure.

product.name: Custom Solutions
product.description: Tailored financial technology solutions developed to meet specific business needs as requested by clients.
